"Given that $X$ is a continuous random variable with the following probability density function, compute $\text{E}[2e-(e-1)X].$

$$
f(x)=\frac{e}{e{x}^{2}-{x}^{2}},\,1<x<e
$$" :question/worked-solution "First, we simplify using the properties of expected value:

$$
\text{E}[2e-(e-1)X]=2e-(e-1)\text{E}[X]
$$

For a continuous random variable $X$ with probability density function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S,$ we can calculate the expected value using the following formula:

$$
\text{E}[X]={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

So, we calculate the expected value of $X$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{e}x\cdot \frac{e}{e{x}^{2}-{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{e}\frac{e}{ex-x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{e}{e-1}{\int }_{1}^{e}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{e}{e-1}\cdot \operatorname{ln}⁡x|}_{1}^{e} \\  & =\frac{e}{e-1}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[2e-(e-1)X] & =2e-(e-1)\text{E}[X] \\  & =2e-(e-1)\cdot \frac{e}{e-1} \\  & =2e-e \\  & =e.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-40bc13bb-3a56-5bb3-8230-e9e5cf644479"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-40bc13bb-3a56-5bb3-8230-e9e5cf644479" :answer-field/id #uuid "40bc13bb-3a56-5bb3-8230-e9e5cf644479" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-c85412a1-0e83-564f-8a9b-83a321c6575e" :answer-field/choices ["answer-d7fa3a08-2b65-5156-aae1-9ccac58678b5" "answer-e8914a7c-ea0f-5a3e-bdf9-4afc9ee04ada" "answer-77138f44-7002-5bb8-ac6c-cc59e24ef477" "answer-c85412a1-0e83-564f-8a9b-83a321c6575e" "answer-990d8356-79d6-5c6b-8d72-fd39fd724f7e"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-d7fa3a08-2b65-5156-aae1-9ccac58678b5" :answer/id #uuid "d7fa3a08-2b65-5156-aae1-9ccac58678b5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "0" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-e8914a7c-ea0f-5a3e-bdf9-4afc9ee04ada" :answer/id #uuid "e8914a7c-ea0f-5a3e-bdf9-4afc9ee04ada" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3e" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-77138f44-7002-5bb8-ac6c-cc59e24ef477" :answer/id #uuid "77138f44-7002-5bb8-ac6c-cc59e24ef477" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3e-1" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-c85412a1-0e83-564f-8a9b-83a321c6575e" :answer/id #uuid "c85412a1-0e83-564f-8a9b-83a321c6575e" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "e" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-990d8356-79d6-5c6b-8d72-fd39fd724f7e" :answer/id #uuid "990d8356-79d6-5c6b-8d72-fd39fd724f7e" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "e+1" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "question-c64c8376-4f9a-5df0-81b9-bf811d12f7ce" :question/id #uuid "c64c8376-4f9a-5df0-81b9-bf811d12f7ce" :question/math-academy-id "q-152904" :question/problem "Given that $X$ is a continuous random variable with the following probability density function, compute $\text{E}[4X+2].$

$$

$$
\text{E}[X]={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

So, we calculate the expected value of $X$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{0}^{\infty }x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}x\cdot \frac{3}{4}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }x\cdot \frac{1}{2{x}^{3}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{3x}{4}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{2{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={(\frac{3{x}^{2}}{8})|}_{0}^{1}+{(-\frac{1}{2x})|}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =(\frac{3}{8}-0)+(0-(-\frac{1}{2})) \\  & =\frac{3}{8}+\frac{1}{2} \\  & =\frac{7}{8}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[4X+2] & =4\text{E}[X]+2 \\  & =4\cdot \frac{7}{8}+2 \\  & =\frac{11}{2}.\end{aligned}

$$

$$
\text{E}[X]={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{S}x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{e}x\cdot \frac{e}{e{x}^{2}-{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{e}\frac{e}{ex-x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{e}{e-1}{\int }_{1}^{e}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{e}{e-1}\cdot \operatorname{ln}⁡x|}_{1}^{e} \\  & =\frac{e}{e-1}\end{aligned}

$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{0}^{\infty }x\cdot f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}x\cdot \frac{3}{4}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }x\cdot \frac{1}{2{x}^{3}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{3x}{4}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{1}{2{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={(\frac{3{x}^{2}}{8})|}_{0}^{1}+{(-\frac{1}{2x})|}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =(\frac{3}{8}-0)+(0-(-\frac{1}{2})) \\  & =\frac{3}{8}+\frac{1}{2} \\  & =\frac{7}{8}\end{aligned}

\textrm E[X] = \int_S x \cdot f(x) \, \textrm dx

$$
